sources.name: Central Registry of the Republic of North Macedonia (CRM)
sources.verdict: Canonical trade/company register, annual accounts and holder of insolvency-status data. Site verified live but renders only via JavaScript (fetch returns header only). CRM sells a paid 'distribution of information' bulk service; no free open-data dump or public API was verifiable. Machine route requires the paid distribution channel or browser automation.

sources.name: Securities and Exchange Commission (KHV / SEC)
sources.verdict: Verified. Regulator of the capital market; publishes registers/analytics for investment funds, fund management companies, brokerage houses, the exchange, CSD and joint-stock companies. MK/AL/EN versions. No RSS found. This is the register of record for fund managers — key for the PE/liquid-alts side.

sources.name: National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia (NBRNM)
sources.verdict: Verified. Registers of banks, savings houses, payment/e-money institutions and payment system operators under Supervision > Registries; NBStat statistical web portal; press releases with working RSS at /rss.rss.

sources.name: MAPAS — Agency for Supervision of Fully Funded Pension Insurance
sources.verdict: Verified (MK root works; /en/ returned 403 to automated fetch). Register of pension companies and mandatory/voluntary pension funds at mapas.mk/subjekti-pod-supervizija/, MAPAS-STAT statistics portal (mapas.mk/mapastat/), live NAV figures. This is the domestic LP side — pension funds are the largest institutional asset pools in MK.

sources.name: Insurance Supervision Agency (ASO/ISA)
sources.verdict: Verified. Registers of insurance undertakings, brokerage companies, agencies, brokers, agents and certified actuaries at aso.mk/en/registar/; market reports and statistics. Second pillar of the domestic LP side.

sources.name: Public Revenue Office (UJP)
sources.verdict: Verified. Taxpayer search by name/EDB/MB, tax-debtor publications, e-auctions of seized assets (distressed signal source). e-Tax portal is login-only but the public search and announcements are open.

sources.name: Energy and Water Services Regulatory Commission (ERC)
sources.verdict: Real regulator (licenses electricity/gas producers, traders, renewables — key for the real-assets/energy-transition class) but the site returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; needs browser automation or manual pull of licensee registers.

sources.name: Official Gazette — Sluzhben vesnik na RSM
sources.verdict: The official gazette (laws, company/insolvency notices). Verification failed on a TLS certificate error ('unable to verify the first certificate') — site likely live but misconfigured; scraper must tolerate the cert chain. Free issue search exists per prior knowledge; could not confirm this session.

sources.name: CRM insolvency and liquidation announcements
sources.verdict: Bankruptcy/liquidation proceedings are opened via and published by the Central Registry (with the gazette). Same JS-rendered site as the company register; no separate standalone insolvency portal was verifiable. Treat as a CRM data-channel requirement.

sources.name: Judiciary portal of North Macedonia (sud.mk)
sources.verdict: Courts portal with case-law/decision search (insolvency cases sit in the civil courts, Skopje 2 primarily). Connection refused (HTTPS) during verification — could not confirm current state; retry with browser automation.

sources.name: Macedonian Stock Exchange (MSE)
sources.verdict: Verified. Official/Regular/Free market issuer lists, member (broker) list, market data, MBI10 index. Three working RSS feeds: /en/rss/news, /en/rss/seinet (all corporate disclosures — high value), /en/rss/reports. The single best machine feed in the market.

sources.name: SEINet — MSE corporate disclosure system
sources.verdict: Verified live but is a JS SPA (fetch returns only 'SEI Net'). Full-text issuer announcements. Practical machine route: consume via MSE's /en/rss/seinet RSS feed instead of scraping the SPA.

sources.name: Central Securities Depository (CDHV)
sources.verdict: Verified. Member list, registry of JSC issuers, shareholders holding >5% stakes (ownership signal), monthly statistics on shares and takeovers, corporate-event notices. EN version available.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance
sources.verdict: Verified. Government securities auction calendar and prospectuses, public-debt data, fiscal counter, Open Finance portal link, active press-release section. Sovereign/rates context for the credit class.

sources.name: Deposit Insurance Fund (FODSK)
sources.verdict: Verified. Member banks/savings houses list (/chlenki-na-fondot), annual financial reports, announcements. Useful cross-check register for the banking perimeter.

sources.name: Development Bank of North Macedonia (DBNM/MBDP)
sources.verdict: Verified. State-owned DFI: credit lines (CEB/AFD EUR 50M each), portfolio/individual guarantees, export credit insurance, factoring. News at /en/Home/News, public calls at /en/News/JavniOglasi. Key domestic credit-side institution.

sources.name: Invest North Macedonia (Agency for Foreign Investments and Export Promotion)
sources.verdict: Real IPA (FDI pipeline, TIDZ free-zone investors) but returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch. Needs browser automation; FDI announcements also flow through MIA/press.

sources.name: Fund for Innovation and Technology Development (FITR)
sources.verdict: The state startup/innovation grant fund — primary public source of MK startup funding events (grantee lists per call). fitr.mk failed DNS resolution repeatedly during this session; institution still exists — re-verify domain (possible migration) before wiring an adapter.

sources.name: Economic Chamber of North Macedonia
sources.verdict: Verified (note: mchamber.mk, not mchamber.org.mk — old domain has a cert mismatch). 15 associations incl. banking and financial-services groupings, 38 sectoral groupings, news. MK/EN/AL. The de facto home of the banking and fund-industry associations (no standalone sites).

sources.name: Economic Chamber of North-West Macedonia (OEMVP)
sources.verdict: Verified. Albanian-community business chamber; publications, member info, news in AL/MK/EN. Complements mchamber for full corporate-network coverage.

sources.name: AmCham North Macedonia
sources.verdict: Verified. 140+ member directory at /membership/members-list/, advocacy news, position papers. Good corporate-graph and service-provider (law firm/advisor) coverage.

sources.name: MASIT — ICT Chamber of Commerce
sources.verdict: Verified. ICT industry chamber; member list at /chlenki-na-masit/, news at /novosti/. Relevant to the VC/tech company universe.

sources.name: Startup Macedonia
sources.verdict: Verified. National startup ecosystem association with a data platform (app.startupmacedonia.mk) holding startup and support-organization databases, ecosystem reports. The closest thing MK has to a VC-ecosystem directory — there is no PE/VC association.

sources.name: Bar Association of RNM (AKRSM)
sources.verdict: Verified. Register of active attorneys at /index.php/mk/imenik-advokati/imenik-aktivni-advokati, plus suspended/removed lists. Service-graph coverage for law firms.

sources.name: Notary Chamber of RNM (NKRM)
sources.verdict: Verified. Directory of notaries by municipality at /index.php/pages/imenik-na-notari; annual reports. Notaries handle enforcement/pledge work relevant to credit.

sources.name: Institute of Certified Auditors (IORRM)
sources.verdict: Verified. Public registers at /registers: 205 certified auditors, 28 audit firms, 17 sole practitioners. Service-graph (fund auditor) coverage.

sources.name: State Statistical Office (MakStat)
sources.verdict: Verified, with a caveat: stat.gov.mk is now the frozen old site (banner says unchanged since Apr 2025) redirecting users to the new www.stat.mk. MakStat is a PX-Web database (standard PX-Web JSON API), business-entity and structural business statistics, press releases with RSS on the old site. Wire the adapter against stat.mk.

sources.name: Public Procurement Bureau e-procurement portal
sources.verdict: The national e-procurement system (tender + award data = revenue signals for infra/EPC entities). Returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; a JS application. Needs browser automation; check bjn.gov.mk (Bureau) for bulletins as an alternate route (unverified this session).

sources.name: Agency for Real Estate Cadastre
sources.verdict: Real-asset ownership backbone (e-cadastre, OSSP geoportal). HTTPS connection refused during verification — could not confirm current state; known to require accounts for most extracts. Re-verify with browser.

sources.name: National open data portal
sources.verdict: Government open-data portal (CKAN-based historically; linked from Ministry of Finance). Connection refused during this session's check — flaky hosting; worth re-testing for any CRM/ministry datasets before paying for CRM distribution.

sources.name: Kapital
sources.verdict: Verified working RSS. The leading dedicated business/finance weekly+portal: corporate results, energy, capital markets, banking. Hourly updates, MK language. Top-priority signal source.

sources.name: Faktor
sources.verdict: Verified working RSS (global feed plus per-category feeds: Economics, Finance, Analysis, Balkans). Strong economy/finance desk within a general portal.

sources.name: BiznisInfo
sources.verdict: Verified working RSS, hourly updates. Macedonian business news: NBRM decisions, public debt, corporate results (e.g. OKTA), regional/global business.

sources.name: Pari
sources.verdict: Verified. Dedicated business/finance/investment-funds portal (bank results, stock exchange, pension and investment funds). WordPress — /feed/ almost certainly exists but was not directly verified; confirm before wiring.

sources.name: SDK — Sakam Da Kazham
sources.verdict: Verified WordPress news site (independent journalism, economy among topics). Standard /feed/ and /index.php/feed/ both returned 404 — feed disabled or nonstandard; scrape index or hunt category feeds.

sources.name: MIA — Media Information Agency
sources.verdict: Verified working RSS. State news agency — official announcements, FDI/government economic news wire. Broad, but the economy section is a reliable primary wire.

sources.name: IT.mk
sources.verdict: Verified working RSS, hourly. Largest MK tech community/media: local startup funding, FITR calls, regional (Balkan) startup and VC news. Best local startup-signal feed.

sources.name: Ekonomija i Biznis
sources.verdict: Verified. Skopje economy/business monthly (print+digital): interviews, economy, business analysis. No RSS found on page — index scrape.

sources.name: Lider
sources.verdict: Known business/economy portal; fetch returned only the site title (JS-rendered). Needs browser automation or feed discovery in-browser.

sources.name: The Recursive
sources.verdict: Verified working RSS (Ghost). CEE/SEE startup and VC media; MK coverage is sporadic (none in current feed window) but it is the main English-language outlet that covers MK rounds when they happen.

sources.name: SeeNews
sources.verdict: Regional SEE business wire with regular North Macedonia corporate/M&A/energy coverage and the TOP 100 SEE ranking. Returned 403 to automated fetch; partially paywalled — headline-level monitoring only, respecting ToS.

sources.name: Bloomberg Adria
sources.verdict: Regional (Adria/Western Balkans) financial media with dedicated Macedonia coverage. Not fetch-verified this session (added on strong prior knowledge); verify feed availability before wiring. Honor its licensing — headline+link only.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Best structured coverage of the MK startup/VC slice. Startup Macedonia's app.startupmacedonia.mk is a Dealroom-style ecosystem database (startups, support orgs, investors); Dealroom's global platform carries the same thin MK layer. Nothing on PE, credit, or real assets.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Startup Macedonia community submissions, FITR grant-call results, IT.mk/The Recursive press, company self-reporting. Direct routes for us: FITR grantee lists, Startup Macedonia public pages, IT.mk RSS.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Near-zero dedicated MK coverage — a handful of regional funds (SEE-focused PE like Mid Europa-adjacent or EBRD-backed vehicles) tagged with North Macedonia as a geography. No local GP/LP depth; MK pension funds not profiled as LPs in any depth.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Press releases, fund-manager self-reporting, EBRD/EIF/IFC project disclosures. Direct routes for us: EBRD/EIF project pages, MAPAS pension registers, SEC fund-manager register.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The deepest commercial company-financials coverage of MK: full-company financial statements, industry reports, news aggregation. Paywalled B2B product.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CRM annual accounts (paid distribution), State Statistical Office data, MSE/SEINet disclosures, local press (Kapital, Faktor). All of these are directly accessible to us: CRM paid channel, stat.mk PX-Web API, MSE RSS trio.

competitorAnalysis.platform: CompanyWall / Bonitet.mk / D&B partners (local credit bureaus)
competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Company credit reports, scoring and debtor flags for MK companies; sell repackaged registry data to local B2B users.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CRM company register + annual accounts (bulk distribution contract), UJP tax-debtor lists, court/insolvency announcements, gazette notices. Direct routes for us: identical public/paid-registry channels — no need to touch their platforms.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Thin, self-reported MK startup profiles; funding data patchy and often missing FITR grants.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Founder self-submission and press. Direct route for us: FITR + IT.mk + The Recursive give better primary coverage.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Regional rankings and company intelligence including MK's largest companies by revenue; M&A and energy-deal newsflow.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CRM/SSO financials, MSE disclosures, company reports, own reporting. Direct routes for us: same registries plus MSE /en/rss/seinet.

searchedButAbsent: Session constraint disclosed honestly: the WebSearch budget was exhausted before this task started (200/200 used), so discovery relied on domain knowledge plus direct URL verification via fetch — every source above marked 'parseable-index', 'rss' or 'js-blocked' was fetch-verified this session; 'unknown' means the site failed verification (DNS/TLS/connection) and needs a re-check. Genuinely absent or not found for North Macedonia: (1) No national PE/VC association exists (no MK member association in Invest Europe; startup ecosystem is organized under Startup Macedonia instead). (2) No AIF/alternative-fund register — SEC publishes only licensed fund-management companies and open-end (UCITS-style) funds; MK has no AIFMD-equivalent public AIF register. (3) No crypto/MiCA/TVTG licensee register — MK is not an EU member, has no crypto licensing regime, and NBRM publishes only warnings, not licenses. (4) No national carbon registry — MK is outside the EU ETS; no domestic voluntary-carbon registry found. (5) Privatization agency — dissolved years ago; no successor register online. (6) No standalone banking association website verified — the banking association operates as an association within the Economic Chamber (mchamber.mk); same for the investment-fund industry grouping. (7) Chamber of certified appraisers/valuers — established by the Law on Appraisal, but no working public directory site could be verified without search; needs a browser session. (8) Register of insolvency trustees (stecajni upravnici) — maintained under the Ministry of Economy/CRM framework, but no standalone public roll was verifiable this session. (9) No REIT regime and no litigation-funding, royalty-fund, or ILS entities found. (10) Verification failures to re-run with a browser: slvesnik.com.mk (TLS misconfiguration), sud.mk and katastar.gov.mk and data.gov.mk (connection refused), fitr.mk (DNS failure — possible domain migration), erc.org.mk / e-nabavki.gov.mk / investnorthmacedonia.gov.mk / seenews.com (HTTP 403 to non-browser fetch). Count honesty: 41 real sources catalogued; padding to 50 was not possible for this market without inventing entries.
